release_notes:
V20.3 — Performance & Startup Optimization Suite:

- Instant App Startup (2M+ Images Ready): Replaced heavy blocking startup queries with persistent database count caching, eliminating 'Not Responding' freezes and 0-count stalls on high-volume workstations.
- Asynchronous Count Reconciliation: Recounts and folder sync execute in non-blocking background threads, ensuring the UI is immediately interactive.
- Frontend Optimistic Hydration: Image counters restore instantly from local storage cache before IPC calls complete, avoiding count flickers.
- On-Demand Fuzzy Engine: Decoupled heavy memory preparation from application startup while preserving 100% comprehensive candidate discovery and scoring precision.

previous_versions.release_notes:
V20.2 — Instant Type-to-Search & Self-Updater Suite:

- Instant Type-to-Search: In Image Viewer workspace, typing any character instantly focuses and enters search without clicking the search bar, streamlining high-volume inspections.
- In-App Self-Update Suite: Fully integrated one-click update downloading with live progress bar and automated Windows installer launch.
- Synchronized Version Labels: All workspace documentation, navigation, and settings labels stay continuously synchronized across application restarts.
- Performance & Stability: Enhanced keyboard event handling and search input responsiveness.

V20.1 — Improvements & Fixes:

- Persistent Theme: Dark / Light mode preference is now stored directly in the SQLite database and reliably preserved across application restarts.
- Refined Live OSD HUD: Stripped 'Customer Care Center' from office names to show clean, concise office location text with hover tooltip; Live connection status is displayed as clean 'Connected' text (no pill); removed redundant PDF button.
- Responsive Image Previews: Fixed stale preview bug when searching subsequent consumers without spot images; properly clears overview grid and presents clear 'No Spot Images' status card.
- Stability & Engine Enhancements: Fixed packaging and module loading compatibility.

V20.0 — Major UI Transformation & Feature Overhaul:

- Complete Web UI Rewrite: Migrated from legacy Tkinter/CustomTkinter to a modern PyWebView + Edge WebView2 powered single-page app with Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and glassmorphic design language.
- Photoshop-Style Workspace: VS Code inspired icon rail sidebar, collapsible accordion dock panels (Details, Dates, Notes), and full dark/light theme toggle.
- Interactive Image Viewer: Mouse wheel zoom, click-drag pan, 90° rotation, real thumbnail filmstrip with preview-all grid mode.
- Bill Calculator Studio: Complete WBERC-accurate energy billing with TOD support, government subsidy slabs, meter rent by phase, timely/special/e-payment rebates, and minimum charge floor.
- Dual-Ledger Theft Assessment: Side-by-side provisional vs final assessment with automatic relief comparison and statutory 25% limit indicator.
- Batch Fuzzy Lookup Engine: Upload/download Excel-based name+address fuzzy matching with ancestor/relative detection, configurable thresholds, and 1-click OSD check per candidate.
- Manual Fuzzy Lookup: Type individual rows directly in-app for instant results without file upload.
- Live WBSEDCL OSD Integration: Real-time Outstanding Statement fetcher with PDF parsing, connection status flags (Live/Deemed/Disconnected), cached portal queries, and floating HUD widget visible in both single-image and grid-preview modes.
- Low Consumption Audit: Automated flagging of zero/low-consumption consumers from Excel data with session persistence.
- Tariff Manager: Full CRUD editor for energy slabs, ED slabs, fixed charges, and load factors.
- Network Folder Management: Multi-folder image source with online/offline status indicators and background re-indexing.
- Silent Auto-Updater: In-app update checking with one-click silent installer download and execution.
- Bundled Suite: Includes SpotImageViewerV20.0.exe and imagecheckgui.exe with Windows Setup installer.

V19.4 Updates:

- Modern Navigation & UI: Refactored with Windows 11 Fluent style sidebar navigation, responsive layout, and unified tool workspace.
- Dynamic Dark / Light Themes: Coordinated one-click theme switcher across CustomTkinter and TTKBootstrap components.
- Embedded Workspace Tools: Bill Calculator, Theft Assessment, Low Consumption Audit, and Tariff Editor can now be launched directly in-frame or detached into separate windows.
- Bill Calculator Modern Date Range Picker: Standardized DD.MM.YYYY format with fast month/year jump controls.
- Complete Bundled Suite: Includes SpotImageViewerV19.4.exe and imagecheckgui.exe with seamless silent auto-updater.

V19.3 Updates:

- In-App Self-Updating: Automated installer packaging and silent background update execution with progress dialog.
- Bill Calculator Modern Date Range Picker: Added modern Month and Year dropdown selectors and fast step navigation for Pro-Rata billing.
- Standardized Date Format: Pro-Rata dates now default to and strictly format as DD.MM.YYYY.
- WBERC Subsidy Rule Enforcement: Domestic government relief correctly caps strictly at <= 300 units/month (or proportional pro-rata/quarterly limit).
- Fast Image Indexing Fix: Network and additional folders dynamically reloaded without stale cache, preserving ultra-fast raw slicing for 1M+ images.
- Bundled Application Suite: Includes both SpotImageViewerV19.3.exe and imagecheckgui.exe with Windows Setup installer.

V19.2 Updates:

- Integrated WBSedcl Meter Verification tool (Image Check GUI) directly into the main app Tools menu.
- Configured multi-executable compilation workflow to bundle both Spot Image Viewer and the Image Check GUI tool.
- Upgraded application suite release to V19.2.

V19.1 Updates:

- Added full Consumer Data workflow with fields: Consumer ID, Meter No, Name, Address, Mobile Number, Contractual Load, and Class.
- Added Name and Mobile search support with proper multi-result handling.
- Improved Details pane to show complete consumer information in compact wrapped format.
- Added Update Consumer Data action dialog with two options: Generate Template and Import Consumer Data.
- Added consumer data template generator (.xlsx) with required headers for easy copy/paste workflows.
- Search controls UI refined for alignment, spacing consistency, and better button behavior when consumer data is unavailable.
- Meter/Name/Mobile search controls are now disabled until consumer data is imported, with clear inline guidance.

V18.4 Updates:

- Image Viewer: Scroll mouse wheel to zoom in/out on images.
- Image Viewer: Click and drag to pan/move around when zoomed in.
- Theft Calculator: UI redesigned to match a consistent table-aligned layout.
- Bug fixes and visual improvements.
